content.comment_body: Hello, We're experiencing an unusual issue where a selection area remains visible and cannot be removed. (Image sourced from a colleague's computer) The selection object persists even after deleting all blocks. It can be selected and resized, but not moved or deleted. A video shows this behavior as seen on my own system. I'm considering sharing the project for review if I can find a method to clear any project usage statistics.
Attached is the project file exhibiting the glitch. Project usage statistics were successfully deleted from my colleague's work thanks to assistance from [user_name] in another discussion ([url]).

Hello [user_name], Unfortunately, I don't have an immediate solution. I've previously encountered situations where incomplete blocks remained invisible and weren't deleted by the user. This prevented program transfer to the [product_name]. However, by accessing "Block Properties (All Blocks)", then "Select block from drawing", I was able to locate and remove the invisible block. Your situation seems like a case for the Support team.

Hello, Thank you for your suggestions. My colleague copied the entire program and pasted it into a new project. The problematic selection block did not transfer, and downloading the new program to [product_name] worked without issue. I've seen similar problems before, typically connected to an off-page connector being selected. Usually, selecting a nearby item will refresh and clear the lingering selection area. This time, no solution worked. Submitting a Support Request is logical, but I prefer not to open one, as initial support staff often need to escalate the matter, especially when there is no urgent customer project at risk. If the software developers monitor these forums, they can retrieve the program from here. That's why the project was shared. Thanks for your time.
I've forwarded this issue to the appropriate team, but I can't confirm whether it will be addressed. [product_name] Support

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering a persistent selection area bug within a [company_name] software product, where a graphical selection area cannot be deleted or removed even after all related blocks are deleted. The selection remains interactive but immovable and undeletable, causing workflow interruptions. The issue is linked to off-page connectors, with workarounds occasionally effective but not working in this instance. Users express frustration with formal support channels and instead opt to share the issue informally, hoping developers notice.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect selection areas to be removable and for the software interface to reliably update after deletions. They hope graphical glitches can be quickly resolved without needing support escalation or complicated workarounds.
